title: はがれがしー
description:
Peel, jump, swap - Embark on a grand sticky adventure with Perin!
Help Perin, the protagonist of this story, travel a world plunged into stickery-madness brought upon a witch's mischief in a puzzle-action game depicting their legacy.

The key to strategy in this game is "how" you interact with the stickers.Slow-peelBend the stickers to your will by slowly peeling it off from the corners!
It might even create new platforms to step on...?

Change the order on how the stickers are placed!

By reforming the stickers, maybe the path forward might just unveil themselves..?Power-peelRip the stickers off with one swift move by storing power!
It might create enough force to do a bigger jump if you're on it..?

Enemies layered on top won't stand a chance against it!
Estimated total play time2 and a half hours - 3 hours
